verdict.rationale: Synthesia has a public API (Video, Upload, Billing, and Localization APIs) and an MCP integration, so asking whether it offers scoped API credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped, permission-limited, or least-privilege API keys for an agent. The existence of the API and MCP alone does not show credential scoping, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
